decision_rule: A wrong argument to scanf/printf (missing &, wrong conversion specifier, value passed instead of address) is OTHER_ERROR, even when Valgrind or ASan then report uninitialised values or a crash as a consequence.
A variable that is used while still unset because the program reads input that is never given (the read fails and leaves it unassigned) is UNINITIALIZED_VAR.
A wrong boundary index in a check or condition (for example a hard-coded 'last index' test that misses the final element) is OFF_BY_ONE, even when the fix is not a plain +1 or -1.
